responsibility: Implements GCC’s main GENERIC/GIMPLE expression folding engine. This file owns the broad set of tree simplifications and constant evaluations used across front ends and the middle end: arithmetic and comparison canonicalization, conversions, pointer and size folding, bit reasoning helpers, conditional/range simplifications, builtin-aware rewrites, and fold_build* support that constructs simplified tree nodes while preserving type, overflow, and source-location semantics. It is the central implementation behind the APIs declared in fold-const.h, with fold-const-call.c handling the narrower function-call subproblem.
same_name_distinction: Contains the main implementation of GCC’s general tree expression folder and fold_build* machinery declared in gcc/fold-const.h; unlike gcc/fold-const-call.c, it handles the broad expression simplification engine rather than the specialized folding of builtin/internal function calls.
